canonical_claims.title: Additive Combo Delta Scoring (No Multipliers)
canonical_claims.statement: Combo points calculate deltaCoins = Max(0, gift.Coins - existing.Coins) and deltaQuantity = Max(0, gift.Quantity - existing.Quantity). If deltaQuantity == 0, deltaCoins is clamped to 0. No mathematical multiplier (mul/mul.ovf) is executed in the scoring path.
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Implement strictly additive delta math with zero-clamping for non-increasing combo quantities.

canonical_claims.title: 5-Tier Recipient Priority Resolution
canonical_claims.statement: Gift routing resolves strictly in order: (1) UI manual override, (2) Active combo streak lock, (3) Sender-specific target rule, (4) Round gift rule, (5) Pending unassigned queue.
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Enforce exact 5-tier short-circuit priority hierarchy for gift attribution.

canonical_claims.title: Dual-Table Combo Persistence & Re-anchoring
canonical_claims.cil_anchors: WriteCombo: IL_0000 - IL_0087; Gift_b0: IL_0948 - IL_0968
canonical_claims.statement: Active streaks reside in 'pending_combos'. Upon streak close, record is inserted into 'combos' and removed from 'pending_combos'. Encountering a closed streak with empty combo_id initiates a fresh combo state.
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Store active combos in pending table and finalize into combos table upon closing.

canonical_claims.title: SQLite WAL Pre-Migration Backup & Revision Concurrency
canonical_claims.cil_anchors: Upgrade: IL_0031 - IL_01bd; CommitGiftCombo: IL_0097 - IL_00b8
canonical_claims.statement: Database executes automatic backup to 'backups/before-continuous-{timestamp}.db' prior to schema upgrades. Writes use revision = revision + 1 optimistic concurrency with journal_mode=WAL and busy_timeout=5000.
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Implement WAL mode, busy_timeout=5000, pre-migration database snapshotting, and revision-based optimistic locking.

canonical_claims.title: Overlay WebSocket Protocol & 250ms Debounce Throttling
canonical_claims.statement: Broadcasts JSON 'team_state' packets to WebSocket clients (default port 3784). Throttles emissions to minimum 250ms interval via teamLastStateSent timestamp and teamStatePending deferred task.
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Throttle overlay broadcast events to 250ms minimum intervals with trailing deferred execution.

canonical_claims.title: Dynamic Media HTTP Port Derivation & Port Hopping
canonical_claims.cil_anchors: SyncMedia: IL_0d72 - IL_0d7e; StartMediaCore: IL_0356 - IL_03e0
canonical_claims.statement: Media server base port is derived as int.Parse(websocketport) + 1 (default 3785). On HttpListenerException collision, waits 300ms and retries on port + 1 up to 3 times (3785 -> 3786 -> 3787 -> 3788). Serves 14 file extensions with application/octet-stream fallback.
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Derive media port dynamically from websocketport + 1 with 3 retry hops (+1, 300ms delay) and 14 MIME types dictionary.

canonical_claims.title: Embedded Script Structural Validation & SHA-256 Fingerprinting
canonical_claims.statement: EmbeddedScriptLoader enforces 1MB payload ceiling, trims UTF-8 BOM, validates JS MIME types, blocks null bytes, checks denial error tokens, and computes SHA-256 as internal immutable content identity without external whitelist check.
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Enforce 1MB limit, MIME checks, no null bytes, structural JS tokens, and content-derived SHA-256 fingerprinting.

canonical_claims.title: Scenario Engine 256 Queue Bound & Arithmetic Clamping
canonical_claims.cil_anchors: Tick: IL_03a9 - IL_03ba; AddState: IL_04ad - IL_04c5
canonical_claims.statement: Scenario tick scheduler limits pending actions to at most 256 items per cycle via Enumerable.Take(256). State variable additions are clamped to [-1,000,000, 1,000,000]. Condition tree evaluates group, time, data, and random branches.
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Enforce 256 action queue limit per tick, [-1M, 1M] state clamping, and short-circuit condition evaluation.

canonical_claims.title: BlazePose Sigmoid Clamping, 2254 Anchors & Squat State Machine
canonical_claims.cil_anchors: Sigmoid: IL_0013 - IL_0025; Squat: IL_0120 - IL_0180
canonical_claims.statement: Sigmoid activation clamps input to [-80, 80]. Anchor generator produces 2,254 boxes (28x28x2, 14x14x2, 7x7x6). Squat state machine cycles: STANDING (>160 deg) -> DESCENDING (<140 deg) -> SQUATTING (<=100 deg) -> rep increment. OBS v5 uses SHA256 challenge-response.
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Implement Sigmoid clamp [-80, 80], 2254 BlazePose anchors, 160/140/100 deg squat hysteresis, and standard OBS v5 handshake.

canonical_claims.title: Win32 Hotkey Message Decoding & Scancode Synthesis
canonical_claims.statement: Processes WM_HOTKEY (0x0312): modifiers decoded from LOWORD (LPARAM & 0xFFFF), virtual key from HIWORD ((LPARAM >> 16) & 0xFFFF). Synthesizes DirectX scancodes for target game windows.
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Decode WM_HOTKEY modifiers and virtual key codes accurately and emit corresponding hardware scancodes.

canonical_claims.title: TikTok Live Event Deserialization & Deduplication
canonical_claims.statement: Ingests TikTok JSON events (gift, comment, like, member). Deduplicates gifts using message_id and combo_id sliding buffer to prevent double-scoring.
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Implement JSON event deserialization with sliding-window deduplication on message_id and combo_id.

canonical_claims.title: EffectProcessTrust RSA-2048 Named Pipe Peer Authentication
canonical_claims.statement: Validates OBS/Studio plugin trust using RSA-2048 public key embedded at string token 0x700061e8 to verify effects-trust.json manifest. Rejects manifests exceeding size threshold. Authenticates Named Pipe peers before allowing effects IPC.
canonical_claims.validation_harness: Báo cáo 27 CIL verification, Báo cáo 34 Contradiction A2/A3 reconciliation
canonical_claims.clean_room_rule: Design secure IPC authentication between host app and plugin processes; do not copy embedded proprietary RSA public key.

debunked_claims.origin: Phase 9 Report 29 conflation with SQLite busy_timeout=5000 pragma (0x7000f906)
debunked_claims.verdict: DEBUNKED: No 5000-5050 port range exists. Media server port is websocketport + 1 (3785..3788).

debunked_claims.topic: Script SHA-256 Whitelist Verification in EmbeddedScriptLoader
debunked_claims.origin: Phase 7 CLAIM-06 conflation with EffectProcessTrust RSA signature verification
debunked_claims.verdict: DEBUNKED: EmbeddedScriptLoader computes SHA-256 solely as an in-memory content identity, not checked against any whitelist.
